spec.scope: Drunken stack acquisition + self Hit Rate ▼ 20% per stack; Hit Rate feeds the hrCoreMult core-rate path (her own MG core hits), not a generic damage stat
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' = no expiry; stacks persist until the Hangover wipe. maxStacks 3, +1 per activation
spec.triggerIdentity: stageEnter stage:1 — fires when ANY unit casts a Stage-1 burst (Mast is Burst II and can never cast B1 herself, so a self burstCast reading fires ZERO times). Fires BEFORE her own B2 cast in the chain (B1 → 30f → B2), so her burst always sees the freshly-added stack
spec.targetSet: self only (Drunken is a self status; the Hit Rate ▼ debuffs only Mast)
spec.nearestWrongModel: Stack gain keyed to fullBurstEnter instead of stageEnter:1 — FB entry lands AFTER B2 and B3, so rotation-1 would show 0 stacks at her burst cast and at the skill2 B3-entry check; alternatively the Hit Rate ▼ dropped entirely as 'defensive/inert'
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On rotation 1, a Drunken stack exists BEFORE Mast's burstCast event (her stack-scaled burst ATK line emits buffApply with 1-stack value ~19,732 flat, and skill2's stageEnter:3 block fires with 1 stack) — RED if stacks key to fullBurstEnter (0 stacks at those moments). For the HR line: Mast's own damage events show reduced core rate after the first stack vs a pre-stack baseline
spec.inertness: Must NOT touch allies' core/crit rates; must NOT add stacks on B2 or B3 casts; stack count must never exceed 3

spec.kitLine: only when in Drunken → allies, Critical Rate ▲
spec.scope: Generic (unscoped) Critical Rate — applies to all hit categories; NOT critRateNormalPct (no 'normal attacks' scoping in the text)
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' = status-tracked, not a timed window: active while Drunken stacks ≥ 1, DROPS when the Hangover wipe zeroes stacks, returns on the next B1 cast. Does NOT scale with stack count (flat 20.05% at any 1–3 stacks)
spec.triggerIdentity: Status-conditional passive gated on Mast's own Drunken status (a resourceGate-on-stacks shape), NOT a timed re-application
spec.nearestWrongModel: Permanent passive from t=0 — active before the first Stage-1 cast and straight through the post-Hangover gap, over-crediting team crit for ~the opening seconds plus every 10s+ hangover window
spec.distinguishingAssertion: No critRatePct 20.05 buffApply (and no crit-rate lift on ally damage events) before the first Stage-1 burst cast; after the FB-end that wipes stacks, ally damage events in the gap before the next B1 show sheet crit rate — RED under an always-on passive
spec.inertness: Value must not scale with stack count; must not apply to the boss

spec.kitLine: ATK ▲ 35.02% of the skill user's ATK
spec.scope: casterAtkPct — flat ATK add scaled off MAST's ATK, not each ally's own (an atkPct misread under-credits high-ATK carries and over-credits nobody consistently)
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' = status-tracked like the crit line: live while stacks ≥ 1, drops on Hangover wipe, no stack scaling
spec.triggerIdentity: Same Drunken-status-gated passive as the crit line
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoded as atkPct 35.02 (scales each target's own ATK) instead of casterAtkPct, or made permanent from t=0
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply emits stat 'casterAtkPct' with FLAT value ≈ 0.3502 × 98,367 ≈ 34,448 on every ally (identical flat number regardless of the target's own ATK) — RED if the value equals 35.02 (raw pct = atkPct misread) or if it appears before the first B1 cast
spec.inertness: Flat value identical across targets; absent during the post-Hangover zero-stack gap

spec.scope: distributedDamagePct — boosts each RECIPIENT's own distributed-flavored hits only; inert on any ally with no distributed damage (do not re-bucket as generic Damage Up)
spec.durationSemantics: Genuine wall-clock 'for 10 sec' (durationSec 10); value snapshots the LIVE stack count at trigger time — 15.03 × stacks, so 15.03 / 30.06 / 45.09 across rotations 1/2/3 of a cycle
spec.triggerIdentity: stageEnter stage:3 (ANY ally casting a Stage-3 burst; Mast is B2 and never casts B3 herself) + Drunken gate (stacks ≥ 1). Given a B1 in team the gate is de-facto always satisfied at B3 time — the load-bearing part is the ×stacks scaling
spec.nearestWrongModel: Authored flat at the max-stack magnitude 45.09 every rotation (the calibration-hiding classic), or given no duration ('continuously')
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Rotation-1 buffApply value = 15.03 and rotation-3 value = 45.09, each with a 10s expiresFrame — RED if every rotation emits 45.09 or if expiresFrame implies no expiry
spec.inertness: Must not move a comp with zero distributed-damage dealers (bucket check); must not fire pre-B3

spec.kitLine: Reload Speed ▲ 15.04% x stacks for 10 sec
spec.scope: reloadSpeedPct — a weapon-state modifier that IS damage (shortens reload, raises shots fired; taxonomy #6 — never 'skip, defensive')
spec.durationSemantics: Wall-clock 10s; value = 15.04 × live stacks at B3 entry (15.04 / 30.08 / 45.12)
spec.triggerIdentity: Same stageEnter:3 + Drunken-gate block as the distributed line
spec.targetSet: all allies including self (Mast's own 171-frame MG reload benefits too)
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipped as a non-damage utility line, or authored flat at 45.12
spec.distinguishingAssertion: An ally whose reload falls inside the 10s window shows a shortened reload (reload events closer together / more shot events per fight) vs the override with this block nulled via withPatchedOverride; buffApply values step 15.04 → 30.08 → 45.12 across the first three rotations
spec.inertness: No reload change outside the 10s windows

spec.kitLine: max stacks at end of Full Burst → Hangover
spec.scope: Self stun 10s + full stack wipe. NOT defensive-inert: the stun stops Mast's MG fire for ~600 frames (shot-count loss) AND the wipe drops every Drunken-gated effect (S1 ally crit + flat-ATK buffs go dark; her Hit Rate ▼ recovers) until the next B1 cast
spec.durationSemantics: Stun durationSec 10; stack removal is instantaneous and total ('Removes all stacks'). The skill2 10s buffs already applied at B3 run out their own clocks independently
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnd trigger + a max-stacks gate (fires ONLY when stacks = 3 at FB end — rotations 1–2 of each cycle must NOT trigger it). Per the engine's stun semantics she can still cast her burst while stunned; she cannot fire/charge/reload
spec.nearestWrongModel: Omitted entirely (stacks then saturate at 3 forever → S1 buffs become permanent and skill2/burst always read ×3 — systematic over-credit), or stacks wiped without the stun, or triggered at EVERY FB end regardless of stack count
spec.distinguishingAssertion: After the FB end where stacks first hit 3 (≈ rotation 3), Mast emits zero shot events for ~10s and the next stageEnter:1 re-grants a 1-stack (not 3-stack) state — subsequent stack-scaled buffApply values restart at the ×1 magnitude. RED if rotation-4 values are still ×3 or her fire is uninterrupted
spec.inertness: Must NOT fire at FB ends with stacks < 3; must not stun allies; must not block her burst cast

spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — fires ONLY on rotations MAST herself casts her Burst II, never on another unit's cast. She is B2: in any fixture with a second B2 (e.g. controlComp's fixed crown slot) burst selection may pick the other unit, and this block must stay silent those rotations
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keyed to fullBurstEnter (or stageEnter:2) — fires every Full Burst even on rotations another B2 casts, over-crediting team crit damage in any two-B2 comp
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In a comp where another Burst-II unit wins a rotation's B2 slot, that rotation has NO critDamagePct 40.04 buffApply; every rotation Mast's own burstCast event appears, the buffApply follows it (pre-FB timing) — RED under fullBurstEnter keying
spec.inertness: Zero applications on rotations she does not cast

spec.scope: attackDamagePct — the additive Damage-Up bucket (diluted by co-active Damage-Up sources), not a true multiplier
spec.triggerIdentity: Same burstCast block as the crit-damage line
spec.nearestWrongModel: Same fullBurstEnter mis-keying as above, or mis-bucketed as atkPct
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat 'attackDamagePct' value 15.04 only on Mast-cast rotations; ally damage events inside the window carry the enlarged Damage-Up bucket

spec.scope: casterAtkPct — flat add off MAST's ATK, scaled by her live Drunken stack count at cast time. The 'if in Drunken' condition is on the CASTER's status (Drunken is her self-status); all allies receive it when she is Drunken
spec.durationSemantics: Wall-clock 10s; magnitude snapshots stacks at cast: because stageEnter:1 precedes her B2 in every chain, a team with a B1 gives her ≥1 stack at every cast — expected sequence ×1, ×2, ×3, (hangover) ×1 …
spec.nearestWrongModel: Flat max-stack value 60.18% every cast, OR encoded as atkPct (percent of each target's own ATK), OR gated per-ally (only 'drunken units' — i.e. self-only)
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Rotation-1 cast emits buffApply stat 'casterAtkPct' with FLAT value ≈ 0.2006 × 1 × 98,367 ≈ 19,732 on all five units; rotation-3 cast emits ≈ 59,197 — RED if constant across rotations, if the value equals the raw percentage, or if only Mast receives it
spec.inertness: Identical flat value across all targets within one cast

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, in descending damage risk: (1) HANGOVER OMITTED OR DEFANGED — without the FB-end wipe+stun, stacks saturate at 3 and the S1 'continuously' buffs become de-facto permanent while every ×stacks magnitude reads ×3; the stun itself is a shots-fired mechanic (taxonomy #6), not defensive flavor. (2) STACK-GAIN TRIGGER — 'entering Burst stage 1' is stageEnter:1 (any B1 cast; Mast is B2 and cannot self-generate it). Keying to fullBurstEnter shifts the grant to AFTER B2/B3, zeroing rotation-1 stack-scaled values; keying to her own burstCast yields zero stacks ever. (3) MAX-STACK FLATTENING — three separate lines scale ×stacks and must snapshot the live count (1/2/3 cycling), not 3. (4) HIT RATE ▼ dropped as inert — it is a self core-rate reduction via the hrCoreMult path; the HR→core slope magnitude is the CALIBRATED ⚑ piece (ALWAYS-⚑ field 7) even though the 20% stat is kit-literal. (5) casterAtkPct vs atkPct on both flat-ATK lines — assert the emitted value is a flat ATK number (~34,448 S1; ~19,732×stacks burst), identical across targets. FIXTURE WARNING: Mast is Burst II — controlComp pins crown into the B2 slot, so a naive controlComp(mast) fixture may never let her cast; the driver must verify a burstCast event for her slug exists before trusting any burst-block assertion, and a two-B2 comp is exactly the configuration where burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter diverges. Encoding shape I'd expect: a Drunken resource pool (initial 0, max 3) with +1 on stageEnter:1, resourceGate min:1 on the gated blocks, wipe (delta -3) + stun on a max-gated fullBurstEnd block; but any encoding passing the assertions above is acceptable — I am blind to the shipped override by design.

driverReconciliation.agreement: Reviewer independently re-derived all 9 kit lines as FAITHFUL + load-bearing, matching the driver disposition exactly. Reviewer corroborated: (a) the fixture must make mrm the SOLE B2 (their FIXTURE WARNING re crown out-picking her in a two-B2 comp is exactly the bug the driver hit and worked around); (b) casterAtkPct resolves to a FLAT caster-ATK grant on both flat-ATK lines; (c) distributedDamagePct boosts only each recipient own distributed hits; (d) reloadSpeedPct is damage (shots-fired), not defensive; (e) the Hangover stun is a shots-fired mechanic, not defensive-inert; (f) the burst buffs key to burstCast (her own casts), NOT fullBurstEnter.
